messages:
jamie: quick ask — can we place a 24h soft hold on one h100 in us-west2 for a partner demo on Tue morning?

sasha: do we have spare reserved quota? last dashboard showed pools ~85% full.

leo: checking... reserved pool counts: us-west2 h100 TOTAL=120, RESERVED=102, AVAILABLE=18 (preemptible 30). so yes one slot is possible but needs a soft-hold toggle and approver.

maria: @jamie what's the tenant identifier the vendor needs? I can reach out to Lane to confirm timing once we have it.

jamie: tenant id: redwood-demo-42. vendor asked for tenant code + confirmation of a hold flag boolean they can see.

leo: infra note — applying a short-term soft-hold requires a tiny infra PR to add tenant to soft-hold map. example below:
```
resource "redwood_infra_hold" "demo_42" {
  tenant     = "redwood-demo-42"
  region     = "us-west2"
  sku        = "h100"
  hold_until = "2026-03-24T16:00:00Z"
}
```
I'll draft the PR and include rollback instructions.

ops-bot: quota-check completed — us-west2 h100 RESERVED:102 AVAILABLE:18 PREEMPTIBLE:30. Carve action requires approver:sasha or approver:oliver

sasha: I can approve once PR is up. jamie, please add vendor contact (lane@cloudpartner.example) and a 2-4h handoff window in the PR description.

jamie: ok will open PR in ~10m. proposing handoff window Tue 2026-03-24 09:00-13:00 PT and will add vendor contact. tagging @sasha for approval.

maria: pinged Lane with tenant id + contact. Lane replied: "we can hold on our side as soon as we see the hold flag and tenant code. please set the handoff window in the PR so we can schedule the transfer." — they also asked for an on-call contact for the handoff.

jamie: adding on-call contact: sasha@redwood.example and will include a brief smoke test steps in PR description (curl to /health and small infer run).

leo: adding a short rollback checklist to the PR comment in case SLO alerts spike. includes removing the hold and notifying vendor. also will add a telemetry tag to track the demo tenant.

sasha: quick caveat — if we drop available pool below 10 during the hold we should auto-revert. i'll include that in approval conditions.

jamie: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4721 — description has hold config, handoff window, vendor contact, smoke test, rollback note. requesting sasha approval.

sasha: reviewing now. one nit: please set hold_until to 16:00Z instead of 14:00Z to cover overrun. lgtm aside from that.

jamie: updated PR to 16:00Z. thanks.

sasha: merged and triggered infra deploy. ops-bot: infra-deploy succeeded at 1767204820.

Lane (CloudPartner): confirmed on their side — we've marked the slot pending and will start handoff at 09:30 PT. will email when the slot is active.

maria: running the smoke test now (small inference request). response looks good.

leo: monitoring SLOs — no anomalies so far. I'll keep an eye until demo ends.

jamie: thanks everyone — updating demo runbook and calendar invite. :thumbsup:
